items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Sir Charles was one [of the young, aspiring, young musicians wanted to meet me]... Wild Bill and Sir Charles came by my house one Sunday afternoon and played all night

ctx.x: He was born I believe on the same street that I was born on in Kansas, Parsons, called Grand Avenue. In fact, he was born about three blocks from me, but he was just one of three or four brothers at that time. I didn't know anything about him playing music until I came back from Shang Hai, China and I went home to visit my mother. And in my house was all of the young, aspiring, young musicians wanted to meet me, Sir Charles was one.
